nodes.title: Bootstrap Monitoring Task on New Subscription

edges.description: Admin must create subjects before users can view and discover them
Users must be able to view subject catalog before they can subscribe
Unsubscribe is the inverse operation of subscribe
Subscription creation triggers bootstrap monitoring task
Subscriptions must exist before users can view their subscriptions
Subjects created by admin provide basis for subscriber count analytics
Subscriptions (user actions) provide data for subscriber count display
Admin user authentication required for subject management
User authentication required to access subject catalog (in secured context)
User authentication required for subscription creation
User authentication required for unsubscribe operations
User authentication required to view personal subscriptions
AI Pipeline (Bloc 3) required for bootstrap task orchestration and execution

implementationOrder.name: Subject Catalog Foundation
implementationOrder.rationale: Admin capabilities and user discovery foundation required before subscription features

implementationOrder.name: User Subscription & Content Triggering
implementationOrder.rationale: Core subscription functionality and bootstrap mechanism for content generation

implementationOrder.name: Subscription Management & Analytics
implementationOrder.rationale: User experience and admin insights into subscription adoption

parallelizable.description: US-1 and US-2 are sequential (must create subjects before viewing)
Subscribe and unsubscribe operations can be developed in parallel after catalog complete
My subscriptions and subscriber count can be developed in parallel after subscriptions exist

externalDependencies.name: Bloc 1 (Authentication)
externalDependencies.notes: All user operations require authentication. Admin operations require admin role. Must be implemented first.

externalDependencies.name: Bloc 3 (AI Pipeline)
externalDependencies.notes: Required for bootstrap task execution. Can stub with logging initially. Core task: trigger_subject_monitoring(subject_id, trigger='bootstrap')

externalDependencies.name: Redis Server
externalDependencies.notes: Required for distributed locking (prevent concurrent bootstrap), Celery broker, and caching

externalDependencies.name: PostgreSQL Database
externalDependencies.notes: Required for Subject and Subscription data persistence. Version 15+.

externalDependencies.name: Celery Task Queue
externalDependencies.notes: Required for async bootstrap task execution. Integrated with Redis broker.

blockerAnalysis.notes: No critical blockers identified. All external dependencies are standard and available. Bloc 3 can be stubbed initially if not yet available.

integrationPoints.description: All user operations require JWT authentication. Admin operations require admin role.
Bootstrap task triggers content generation pipeline
integrationPoints.notes: Can be stubbed initially with logging

integrationPoints.description: Uses subscription data to filter reports on user dashboard
Uses subscription history for user profiling

technicalNotes.architecture: Django REST Framework with Celery async tasks

sequentialDependencies.description: Critical path: subjects created -> visible to users -> users subscribe -> bootstrap triggered
